How a Gaelic harvest fire, two church feasts and a century of American suburbs made Halloween.

On the last night of October, millions of people dress as the dead, carve faces into vegetables and send children to knock on strangers’ doors. It feels like one tradition. It is closer to a pile-up of several, which landed on the same stretch of the calendar.
Early lanterns were turnips and beets in Ireland and Britain. Irish emigrants in the 1800s met the larger, easier pumpkin in North America.
A field guide to the thin night

Pope Leo XIV is recovering from Successful Lung Surgery,"","


The Vatican has confirmed that the American Pope is recovering from a successful lung surgery on the 13th of October 2026.
column2:
The 71-year-old underwent a 90-minute surgery on Tuesday (13.10.2026) at Rome's Gemelli Hospital and was subsequently diagnosed with lung adenocarcinoma.


The Pope is said to have awaken normally, and has since rellocted within Rome’s Gemelli Hospital, where he is expected to stay for about a week.
column3:
Large crowds had waited outside the hospital for the Pope's arrival on Tuesday morning, cheering as he waved and smiled through a window at the crowds as his car drove past.


It was Leo himself who on Sunday announced news of his operation to the world during his weekly Sunday prayers, telling the crowd in St Peter's Square that doctors had found a nodule on his lung.


A nodule is a small, discrete, hard lump or growth that is distinct from the surrounding tissue.


The Vatican said the whole lower lobe of the Pope's right lung was removed ""to ensure the procedure was radical"".


The Vatican has stressed that the Pope, who is generally thought to be fit, had no symptoms of infection or illness.


Cardinal Kikuchi Tarcisio Isao of Tokyo said the Pope - whose schedule has been cleared until 20 October to allow him to recover - had decided to check in for surgery as soon as possible, upon discovering the nodule, because he was willing not to delay a planned trip to South America in early November.


The trip is particularly important to Pope Leo XVI because it includes a visit to Peru, where he was a missionary and then a Bishop for many years.


Since the Pope's diagnosis earlier in the week, it has become publicly aware that his brother, Louis Prevost, was also being treated for a different kind of cancer - multiple myeloma, a form of blood cancer.


Officials had announced just a day before the Pope, revealed his surgery that they were expecting 1.5 million people to travel there to witness his return, due to his peruvian naturalization.


Pope Leo XVI is expected to make a full, speedy and healthy recovery.


It is still unclear, whether or not the Pope must undergo chemotherapy.

The ECO Unit: G9 French Classes Helps Make Compost into Great Soil,"Grade three will plant a strip of flowers this spring!","

This Wednesday (14.10.2026) Grade 9 French classes helped the ECO Team at VIS turn regular compost mostly made out of grass and old leaves into great soil which will be used for a Project on the Japanese Field.


The main mission of Ms. Marti (the leader of the project) was to teach the G9’s about the importance of Great soil and how it impacts our food and wellbeing as well as the wellbeing of animals and microorganisms.


A big part of this project was a hands-on experience which the students got by contributing in a part of the “Compost Cycle”. In a short interview with some of the G9 students participating in the activity we, the SparkNews™ team, have found that some did not greatly appreciate the activity, while others found it great and quite fun


(*How was your Experience* [Interview]. October 14, 2026):

The “not so fun” aspect of things was greatly described by one G9 as “Revolutionary French Peasants Work.” (Probably due to the mixing of the soil being “draining” work).


Although mixed reviews the topics were drastic, some talking about the soil affecting the nutritive value of the fruits and vegetables we eat. (Marti Hendrichs. [Slideshow]. Vienna International School).


Another project of similar type (also lead by Ms. Marti) is a project with students from Grade 3 who will be contributing to the ecosystem by planting a strip of flowers on the Japanese field to welcome pollinators (like bees, butterflies and bumblebees) back to the fields of Donaufeld. Yet even this project got criticism some say that this will “bring more bees and disturb PE sessions”, said jokingly by a member of our community (Disclaimer: Not the opinion of the author nor was this comment taken seriously and was said jokingly).


This project is an important part of being an eco school and is a great example of what VIS does to preserve wildlife and the environment. Although not realised by many soil is very important as the better it is the more nutritious our food becomes and it helps the animals and insects around the area.

هذا الأربعاء (14.10.2026) ساعدت دروس اللغة الفرنسية للصف التاسع فريق ECO في VIS على تحويل السماد العادي المصنوع في الغالب من العشب والأوراق القديمة إلى تربة رائعة يمكن استخدامها بعد ذلك في مشروع في الحقل الياباني.


كانت المهمة الرئيسية للسيدة مارتي (قائدة المشروع) هي تعليم مجموعة التسعة أهمية التربة العظيمة وكيف تؤثر على غذائنا ورفاهنا وكذلك على رفاهية الحيوانات والكائنات الحية الدقيقة.


كان جزء كبير من هذا المشروع عبارة عن خبرة عملية حصل عليها الطلاب من خلال المساهمة في جزء من \""دورة السماد\"" التي قام بها الطلاب من خلال طلاب الصف التاسع المشاركين في النشاط. في مقابلة قصيرة مع بعض الطلاب، وجد فريق SparkNews™ أن النشاط لم يكن مسليًا بالنسبة لمعظم الناس، ومع ذلك وجده البعض رائعًا وممتعًا إلى حد ما (*كيف كانت تجربتك* [مقابلة). 14 أكتوبر 2026). لقد وصف أحد أعضاء مجموعة التسعة الجانب \""غير الممتع\"" للأشياء بشكل كبير بأنه \""العمل الفلاحي الفرنسي الثوري\"". (ربما يرجع ذلك إلى أن خلط التربة هو عمل \""تجفيف\"").


على الرغم من أن المراجعات المختلطة للموضوعات كانت جذرية، يتحدث البعض عن تأثير التربة على القيمة الغذائية للفواكه والخضروات التي نأكلها (مارتي هندريكس. [عرض شرائح]. مدرسة فيينا الدولية).


هناك مشروع آخر من النوع المماثل (بقيادة السيدة ماري أيضًا) سيكون مشروعًا لطلاب من الصف الثالث الذين سوف نساهم في النظام البيئي من خلال زراعة شريط من الزهور في الحقل الياباني للترحيب بعودة الملقحات (مثل النحل والفراشات والنحل الطنان) إلى حقول دوناوفيلد. ومع ذلك، حتى هذا المشروع تعرض لانتقادات، يقول البعض إن هذا \""سيجلب المزيد من النحل ويزعج جلسات التربية البدنية\""، كما قال مازحًا أحد أعضاء مجتمعنا (إخلاء المسؤولية: ليس رأي المؤلف ولم يتم أخذ هذا التعليق على محمل الجد وقيل مازحًا).


يعد هذا المشروع جزءًا مهمًا من كونها مدرسة صديقة للبيئة وهو مثال رائع على ما تفعله VIS للحفاظ على الحياة البرية والبيئة. على الرغم من أن الكثير من التربة لا تدركها إلا أنها مهمة جدًا حيث أنه كلما كانت أفضل كلما أصبح طعامنا أكثر تغذية ورائعًا كما أنه يساعد الحيوانات والحشرات المحيطة.

""},""zh"":{""title"":""ECO 单元：G9 法语课程帮助将堆肥变成优质土壤"",""subtitle"":""三年级学生今年春天将种植一条花"",""content"":""

本周三（2026 年 10 月 14 日）9 年级法语课程帮助 VIS 的 ECO 团队将主要由草和老叶子制成的常规堆肥变成优质土壤，然后用于日本田地的一个项目。


Marti 女士（项目负责人）的主要任务是向 G9 传授优质土壤的重要性以及它如何影响我们的食物和福祉以及动物和微生物的福祉。


这个项目的一个重要部分是实践经验，学生们通过参与“堆肥循环”的一部分而获得了实践经验，学生们通过 G9 学生参与该活动获得了实践经验。在对一些学生的简短采访中，我们 SparkNews™ 团队发现这项活动对大多数人来说不太有趣，但也有一些人觉得它很棒并且有点有趣（*您的体验如何* [采访]。2026 年 10 月 14 日）。九国集团的一位人士将事情“不那么有趣”的一面描述为“革命性的法国农民工作”。 （可能是由于土壤的混合正在“排水”工作）。


尽管评论的主题很激烈，但有些人谈论土壤影响我们吃的水果和蔬菜的营养价值（Marti Hendrichs。[幻灯片]。维也纳国际学校）。


另一个类似类型的项目（也由玛丽女士领导）将是这是一个由三年级学生发起的项目，他们将在日本的田野上种植一条花，欢迎传粉媒介（如蜜蜂、蝴蝶和熊蜂）回到多瑙菲尔德的田野，为生态系统做出贡献。然而，即使这个项目也受到了批评，有人说这会“带来更多的蜜蜂，扰乱体育课”，我们社区的一位成员开玩笑地说（免责声明：这不是作者的意见，也不是认真的，也不是开玩笑的）。


这个项目是生态学校的重要组成部分，也是 VIS 保护野生动物和环境的一个很好的例子。尽管许多人没有意识到土壤非常重要，因为它越好，我们的食物就越有营养和美味，并且可以帮助周围的动物和昆虫。

""},""fr"":{""title"":""L'unité ECO : les cours de français du G9 aident à transformer le compost en un excellent sol"",""subtitle"":""Les élèves de troisième année planteront une bande de fleurs ce printemps"",""content"":""

Ce mercredi (14.10.2026), des cours de français de 9e année ont aidé l'équipe ECO du VIS à transformer un compost ordinaire principalement composé d'herbe et de vieilles feuilles en une bonne terre qui sera ensuite utilisée pour un projet sur le champ japonais.


La mission principale de Mme Marti (la chef du projet) était d'enseigner aux G9 l'importance de la bonne terre et son impact sur notre alimentation et notre bien-être ainsi que sur le bien-être. d'animaux et de micro-organismes.


Une grande partie de ce projet était une expérience pratique que les étudiants ont acquise en contribuant à une partie du «cycle de compostage». Les étudiants du G9 ont participé à l'activité. Dans une courte interview avec certains étudiants, l'équipe SparkNews™ a trouvé l'activité pour la plupart pas très amusante, mais certains l'ont trouvée géniale et plutôt amusante (*Comment s'est passée votre expérience* [Interview]. 14 octobre 2026). L’aspect « pas si amusant » des choses a été largement décrit par un G9 comme étant du « travail paysan révolutionnaire français ». (Probablement parce que le mélange du sol est un travail « drainant »).


Bien que les critiques soient mitigées, les sujets étaient drastiques, certains parlant du sol affectant la valeur nutritive des fruits et légumes que nous mangeons (Marti Hendrichs. [Diaporama]. École internationale de Vienne).


Un autre projet de type similaire (également dirigé par Mme Mary) serait un projet réalisé par des élèves de 3e année qui contribuera à l'écosystème en plantant une bande de fleurs sur le champ japonais pour accueillir les polinateurs (comme les abeilles, les papillons et les bourdons) dans les champs de Donaufeld. Pourtant, même ce projet a été critiqué, certains disent que cela « amènera plus d'abeilles et perturbera les séances d'éducation physique », a déclaré en plaisantant un membre de notre communauté (Avertissement : ce n'est pas l'opinion de l'auteur et ce commentaire n'a pas été pris au sérieux et a été dit en plaisantant).


Ce projet est une partie importante d'être une école écologique et est un excellent exemple de ce que fait VIS pour préserver la faune et l'environnement. Bien que beaucoup ne le réalisent pas, le sol est très important, car plus il est bon, plus notre nourriture devient nutritive et excellente et elle aide les animaux et les insectes qui l'entourent.

""},""ru"":{""title"":""Подразделение ECO: Курсы французского языка G9 помогают превратить компост в великолепную почву"",""subtitle"":""Этой весной третьеклассники посадят полосу цветов"",""content"":""

В эту среду (14.10.2026) уроки французского языка в 9 классе помогли команде ЭКО в VIS превратить обычный компост, в основном сделанный из травы и старых листьев, в великолепную почву, которую затем можно использовать для проекта на японском поле.


Основной миссией г-жи Марти (руководителя проекта) было рассказать членам G9 о важности Великой почвы и о том, как она влияет на наше питание и благополучие, а также благополучие животных и микроорганизмов.


Большой частью этого проекта был практический опыт, который студенты получили, внося свой вклад в часть «компостного цикла». Студенты сделали это. Студенты G9, участвовавшие в мероприятии. В коротком интервью с некоторыми студентами мы, команда SparkNews™, сочли это занятие для большинства не слишком забавным, но некоторым оно показалось замечательным и в некоторой степени забавным (*Как прошел ваш опыт* [Интервью]. 14 октября 2026 г.). «Не очень веселый» аспект вещей был широко описан одним из членов G9 как «революционный французский крестьянский труд». (Вероятно, из-за того, что перемешивание почвы «осушает» работу).


Хотя мнения неоднозначны, темы были радикальными, некоторые говорили о том, что почва влияет на питательную ценность фруктов и овощей, которые мы едим (Марти Хендрикс. [Слайд-шоу]. Венская международная школа).


Другим проектом аналогичного типа (также под руководством г-жи Мэри) будет проект студентов Grade 3, которые внесут свой вклад в экосистему, посадив полоску цветов на японском поле, чтобы приветствовать опылителей (таких как пчелы, бабочки и шмели) обратно на поля Донауфельда. Тем не менее, даже этот проект подвергся критике, некоторые говорят, что это «привлечет больше пчел и помешает занятиям физкультурой», - в шутку сказал член нашего сообщества (Отказ от ответственности: это не мнение автора, и этот комментарий не был воспринят серьезно и был сказан в шутку).


Этот проект является важной частью эко-школы и отличным примером того, что VIS делает для сохранения дикой природы и окружающей среды. Хотя многие это не осознают, почва очень важна, поскольку чем она лучше, тем питательнее и вкуснее становится наша пища, а также помогает животным и насекомым вокруг.

""},""es"":{""title"":""La Unidad ECO: Las clases de francés del G9 ayudan a convertir el abono en un gran suelo"",""subtitle"":""Los estudiantes de tercer grado plantarán una franja de flores esta primavera"",""content"":""

Este miércoles (14.10.2026), las clases de francés de noveno grado ayudaron al equipo ECO en VIS a convertir abono común hecho principalmente de pasto y hojas viejas en una excelente tierra que luego se utilizará para un proyecto en el campo japonés.


La misión principal de la Sra. Martí (la líder del proyecto) fue enseñar a los G9 sobre la importancia de una excelente tierra y cómo afecta nuestra alimentación y nuestro bienestar. de animales y microorganismos.


Una gran parte de este proyecto fue la experiencia práctica que los estudiantes obtuvieron al contribuir en una parte del \""Ciclo de compost\"". Los estudiantes del G9 participaron en la actividad. En una breve entrevista con algunos de los estudiantes, el equipo de SparkNews™ encontró que la actividad para la mayoría no era demasiado divertida, sin embargo, algunos la encontraron genial y algo divertida (*Cómo fue tu experiencia* [Entrevista]. 14 de octubre de 2026). El aspecto “no tan divertido” de las cosas fue ampliamente descrito por un G9 como “trabajo campesino revolucionario francés”. (Probablemente debido a que mezclar la tierra es un trabajo de “drenaje”).


Aunque las críticas mixtas, los temas fueron drásticos, algunos hablaban de que la tierra afecta el valor nutritivo de las frutas y verduras que comemos (Marti Hendrichs. [Presentación de diapositivas]. Escuela Internacional de Viena).


Otro proyecto de tipo similar (también dirigido por la Sra. Mary) sería un proyecto de estudiantes de tercer grado que contribuirá al ecosistema plantando una franja de flores en el campo japonés para dar la bienvenida a los polinizadores (como abejas, mariposas y abejorros) a los campos de Donaufeld. Sin embargo, incluso este proyecto recibió críticas, algunos dicen que \""traerá más abejas y perturbará las sesiones de educación física\"", dicho en broma por un miembro de nuestra comunidad (Descargo de responsabilidad: no es la opinión del autor ni este comentario se tomó en serio y se dijo en broma).


Este proyecto es una parte importante de ser una escuela ecológica y es un gran ejemplo de lo que hace VIS para preservar la vida silvestre y el medio ambiente. Aunque muchos no se dan cuenta, el suelo es muy importante, ya que cuanto mejor es, más nutritivo y excelente se vuelve nuestro alimento, además de ayudar a los animales e insectos que nos rodean.

""},""de"":{""title"":""Die ECO-Einheit: G9-Französischkurse hilft dabei, Kompost in großartigen Boden zu verwandeln"",""subtitle"":""Die dritte Klasse wird diesen Frühling einen Blumenstreifen pflanzen"",""content"":""

Diesen Mittwoch (14.10.2026) halfen Französischkurse der 9. Klasse dem ECO-Team am VIS dabei, normalen Kompost, der hauptsächlich aus Gras und alten Blättern besteht, in großartige Erde umzuwandeln, die dann für ein Projekt auf dem japanischen Feld verwendet werden konnte.


Die Hauptaufgabe von Frau Marti (der Leiterin des Projekts) bestand darin, die G9 über die Bedeutung von großartigem Boden und wie er sich auf unsere Ernährung und unser Wohlbefinden sowie auf die Gesundheit und Gesundheit von Kindern und Jugendlichen aufzuklären, aufzuklären Wohlergehen von Tieren und Mikroorganismen.


Ein großer Teil dieses Projekts waren praktische Erfahrungen, die die Schüler durch ihren Beitrag zu einem Teil des „Kompostzyklus“ erhielten. Die Schüler taten dies. G9-Schüler nahmen an der Aktivität teil. In einem kurzen Interview mit einigen Studenten fanden wir, das SparkNews™-Team, die Aktivität für die meisten nicht besonders amüsant, einige fanden sie jedoch großartig und einigermaßen unterhaltsam (*Wie war Ihre Erfahrung* [Interview]. 14. Oktober 2026). Der „nicht so lustige“ Aspekt der Dinge wurde von einem G9-Mitglied ausführlich als „revolutionäre französische Bauernarbeit“ beschrieben. (Wahrscheinlich, weil die Durchmischung des Bodens eine „Entwässerungsarbeit“ darstellt).


Obwohl die Kritiken gemischt waren, waren die Themen drastisch, einige sprachen davon, dass der Boden den Nährwert der von uns verzehrten Früchte und Gemüse beeinflusst (Marti Hendrichs. [Diashow]. Vienna International School).


Ein weiteres Projekt ähnlicher Art (ebenfalls geleitet von Frau Mary) wäre ein Projekt von Schülern der 3. Klasse Wer wird zum Ökosystem beitragen, indem er einen Blumenstreifen auf dem japanischen Feld pflanzt, um Bestäuber (wie Bienen, Schmetterlinge und Hummeln) wieder auf den Feldern des Donaufelds willkommen zu heißen. Doch selbst dieses Projekt wurde kritisiert. Einige sagen, dass dies „mehr Bienen bringen und den Sportunterricht stören“ würde, scherzhaft von einem Mitglied unserer Community (Haftungsausschluss: Weder die Meinung des Autors, noch wurde dieser Kommentar ernst genommen und im Scherz gesagt).


Dieses Projekt ist ein wichtiger Teil einer Öko-Schule und ein großartiges Beispiel dafür, was VIS zum Schutz der Tierwelt und der Umwelt tut. Obwohl dies von vielen nicht erkannt wird, ist der Boden sehr wichtig, denn je besser er ist, desto nährstoffreicher und großartiger wird unsere Nahrung und es hilft auch den Tieren und Insekten in der Umgebung.

Software Engineer who helped land Apollo 11, dies aged 90,"An engineering legend passed away, aged 90 after helping Apollo 11 land on the moon","

Margaret Hamilton, the computer scientist whose work helped make the historic Apollo 11 Moon landing possible, has died at the age of 90.


Hamilton was born in 1936 and became interested in mathematics and computers at a time when very few women worked in such an occupation. In the 1960s, she joined the team at the Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) that developed the software for NASA's Apollo missions. She eventually became the director of the Software Engineering Division.


Hamilton's work may not have been as visible as that of Neil Armstrong, or Buzz Aldrin, but it was essential. Hamilton led her team to create software that controlled important parts of the Apollo spacecraft.


This careful planning became especially important on July 20, 1969, when Apollo 11 was preparing to land on the Moon. Just before the lunar module reached the surface, the computer began sending warning alarms because it was overloaded with too much information. It looked like a serious problem, but Hamilton's software had been designed to recognize which tasks were most important. In the end, the computer was able to focus on the essential landing operations instead of shutting down.


Thanks in part to this design, Neil Armstrong and Buzz Aldrin were able to continue their descent. Armstrong eventually announced the famous words, “The Eagle has landed,” and humanity had successfully reached the Moon.

Hamilton later became known as one of the people who helped shape the field of software engineering. At the time, programming was still a relatively new area, and the term “software engineer” was not commonly used. Hamilton understood that computer software needed to be treated with the same care and seriousness as other forms of engineering.


Despite her enormous contribution, Hamilton was not always well known by the public. Hamilton's story shows that important achievements are not always made by the people standing in front of the public and the cameras. Sometimes, they come from people working quietly behind the scenes, solving problems and making sure everything works when it matters most.


In 2016, Hamilton received the Presidential Medal of Freedom, one of the United States' highest civilian honors. She continued to be an inspiration to students, scientists and especially young women interested in technology and engineering.


Margaret Hamilton's legacy goes far beyond the Apollo 11 mission. Her work helped humans take their first steps on another world and also helped shape the technology we depend on today. Her story reminds us that even work that happens far from the spotlight can have an enormous impact on history.


Margaret Hamilton may not have walked on the Moon, but her work helped us get there.

Lionel Messi Scores Final Goal of Career,"The 39 year soccer star experienced a emotional moment last night.","

Last night Messi played what everyone says was his final game for Argentina. The team won three to zero against Benin and it felt like a fitting way for things to wrap up. He set up two of the goals and then scored from the penalty spot later on.


His record with the national side is hard to argue with. There were two copa america titles and of course the world cup back in twenty twenty two. He also ended up as the top scorer and the player with the most caps for the country. It seems like he basically did everything possible.


Fans at the stadium made a lot of noise for him from the start. They kept going right through the match too. After the whistle he looked pretty moved when he went around thanking people and talking with the other players.
column2:
For a lot of supporters this was more than just one game. Watching him in the blue and white shirt for so many years made the moment stand out. Some of it still feels kind of hard to picture without him there. His goals and the big wins are going to be talked about for a long time though.

لعب ميسي الليلة الماضية ما يقول الجميع إنها مباراته الأخيرة مع الأرجنتين. فاز الفريق بنتيجة 3-0 على بنين وبدا الأمر وكأنه طريقة مناسبة لإنهاء الأمور. صنع هدفين ثم سجل من ركلة جزاء في وقت لاحق.


من الصعب الجدال حول سجله مع المنتخب الوطني. كان هناك لقبان لكوبا أمريكا وبالطبع كأس العالم في عام 2222. وانتهى به الأمر أيضًا كأفضل هداف واللاعب الذي شارك في أكبر عدد من المباريات الدولية للبلاد. يبدو أنه فعل كل ما هو ممكن.


أحدث المشجعون في الملعب ضجة كبيرة له منذ البداية. لقد استمروا في المضي قدمًا خلال المباراة أيضًا. بعد صافرة الحكم، بدا متأثرًا جدًا عندما كان يشكر الناس ويتحدث مع اللاعبين الآخرين. 


بالنسبة للعديد من المشجعين، كانت هذه أكثر من مجرد مباراة واحدة. إن مشاهدته بالقميص الأزرق والأبيض لسنوات عديدة جعلت هذه اللحظة بارزة. لا يزال من الصعب تصوير البعض منه بدونه. سيتم الحديث عن أهدافه وانتصاراته الكبيرة لفترة طويلة.

""},""zh"":{""title"":""莱昂内尔·梅西 (Lionel Messi) 打进职业生涯最后一球"",""subtitle"":""这位 39 岁的足球明星昨晚经历了一个激动人心的时刻。"",""content"":""

昨晚，梅西踢了所有人都说是他代表阿根廷队的最后一场比赛。球队以三比零战胜贝宁，感觉这是一个合适的结束方式。他助攻了两个进球，随后又通过点球得分。


他在国家队的记录无可争议。有两次美洲杯冠军，当然还有222年的世界杯。他还成为了最佳射手和为国家队出场次数最多的球员。看起来他基本上已经做到了一切。


球场上的球迷从一开始就为他吵闹。他们也一直坚持完成比赛。终场哨响后，当他四处感谢人们并与其他球员交谈时，他看起来很感动。 


对于很多支持者来说，这不仅仅是一场比赛。这么多年看着他穿着蓝白衬衫，这一刻变得格外引人注目。如果没有他在场，有些事情仍然让人难以想象。不过，他的目标和重大胜利将被人们谈论很长时间。

""},""fr"":{""title"":""Lionel Messi marque le dernier but de sa carrière"",""subtitle"":""La star du football de 39 ans a vécu un moment d’émotion hier soir."",""content"":""

Hier soir, Messi a joué ce que tout le monde considère comme son dernier match pour l'Argentine. L’équipe a gagné trois à zéro contre le Bénin et cela semblait être une manière appropriée de conclure les choses. Il a inscrit deux des buts, puis a marqué sur penalty plus tard.


Son bilan avec l'équipe nationale est difficile à contester. Il y a eu deux titres de la Copa America et bien sûr la Coupe du monde en 2022. Il a également fini comme meilleur buteur et joueur avec le plus de sélections pour le pays. On dirait qu'il a fait tout son possible.


Les supporters du stade ont fait beaucoup de bruit pour lui dès le début. Ils ont également continué tout au long du match. Après le coup de sifflet, il avait l'air très ému lorsqu'il remerciait les gens et discutait avec les autres joueurs. 


Pour de nombreux supporters, c'était plus qu'un simple match. Le regarder dans la chemise bleue et blanche pendant tant d’années a fait ressortir ce moment. Une partie de cela semble encore difficile à imaginer sans lui là-bas. Mais on parlera longtemps de ses objectifs et de ses grandes victoires.

""},""ru"":{""title"":""Лионель Месси забивает последний гол в карьере"",""subtitle"":""Вчера вечером 39-летняя звезда футбола пережила эмоциональный момент."",""content"":""

Вчера вечером Месси сыграл, как все говорят, его последнюю игру за Аргентину. Команда выиграла у Бенина со счетом 3:0, и это казалось подходящим завершением матча. Он забил два гола, а затем забил с пенальти.


С его рекордами в сборной трудно спорить. В двадцать втором году было два титула Кубка Америки и, конечно же, чемпионат мира. Он также стал лучшим бомбардиром и игроком, сыгравшим наибольшее количество матчей за сборную страны. Кажется, он, по сути, сделал все возможное.


Болельщики на стадионе с самого начала наделали ему много шума. Они тоже продолжали до конца матча. После свистка он выглядел очень растроганным, когда ходил вокруг, благодарил людей и разговаривал с другими игроками. 


Для многих болельщиков это было больше, чем просто одна игра. Наблюдение за ним в сине-белой рубашке на протяжении стольких лет сделало этот момент особенным. Некоторые вещи до сих пор сложно представить без него. Однако о его целях и больших победах будут говорить еще долго.

Anoche Messi jugó lo que todo el mundo dice que fue su último partido con Argentina. El equipo ganó tres a cero contra Benin y parecía una forma adecuada de terminar las cosas. Asistió en dos de los goles y luego marcó de penalti.


Su historial con la selección nacional es difícil de discutir. Hubo dos títulos de copa américa y por supuesto el mundial allá por el año dos veintidós. También acabó como el máximo goleador y el jugador con más partidos internacionales con el país. Parece que básicamente hizo todo lo posible.


Los aficionados en el estadio hicieron mucho ruido por él desde el principio. También continuaron durante todo el partido. Después del pitido se mostró bastante emocionado mientras caminaba agradeciendo a la gente y hablando con los demás jugadores. 


Para muchos aficionados este fue más que un simple partido. Verlo con la camiseta blanquiazul durante tantos años hizo que el momento se destacara. Algo de esto todavía se siente un poco difícil de imaginar sin él allí. Sin embargo, se hablará de sus goles y de sus grandes victorias durante mucho tiempo.

The kangaroo that turned a famous joke into a real-life headline


LOWER AUSTRIA — 5 OCTOBER 2026


Austria has a famous joke about having
column2:
no kangaroos. This weekend, however, one kangaroo apparently decided that somebody needed to check the facts.

A kangaroo has been spotted several times in the area between
column3:
Kammern near Langenlois and Zöbing in Lower Austria, leaving drivers, police and local residents wondering how a distinctly Australian-looking animal ended up hopping through the Austrian countryside.

A midnight surprise

The unusual story began during the night of Saturday, 3 October.

Four people returning home from a horse event were driving near a DIY store in Kammern, close to Langenlois, when they suddenly encountered something they certainly were not expecting to see on an Austrian road.

A kangaroo was sitting in the middle of the road.

At first, the group apparently could hardly believe what they were seeing. But there was little time for disbelief: the animal was on the road, so the group stopped and contacted the police emergency number.

According to the report, police initially found the story difficult to believe too. About 20 minutes after the call, the group received a response.

An hour-long attempt

The four people tried to get the kangaroo away from the road and, according to the reports, initially attempted to catch it.

The kangaroo had other plans.

After roughly an hour, the group managed to move the animal away from the road and towards a more natural area. The kangaroo then disappeared into the darkness.

But there was one final problem.

While helping the animal, the car's headlights had been left on to illuminate the scene. By around 2 a.m., the battery had gone flat.

The kangaroo had escaped.

The car had not.

The group eventually needed a jump-start before they could continue their journey.

Then came another sighting

The story could have ended there.

It didn't.

On Monday morning, another driver reported seeing a kangaroo near
column4:
Zöbing and the Heiligenstein.

The driver, Sebastian, was travelling to work at around 7 a.m. when the animal suddenly appeared only a short distance away. It hopped into what appeared to be an orchard or vineyard.

He later told Heute that he thought he was dreaming.

The driver contacted police, who reportedly told him that he was not the first person to report seeing the animal.

The kangaroo was even given a temporary name by its latest observer:
column5:
“Sydney.”

But where did it come from?

That remains the biggest mystery.

The reports do not establish where the kangaroo came from or who it belongs to. For now, the animal's movements around the Langenlois–Zöbing area remain unexplained.

And while seeing a kangaroo in Austria sounds completely absurd, this isn't the first time one has appeared in Lower Austria.

In 2024, a wild camera in a forest near Fels am Wagram captured another kangaroo. Its ownership and origin were also unclear at the time.

So… are there kangaroos in Austria?

The famous phrase
column7: is a playful reference to the fact that&nbsp
column8: Austria
column10: Australia
column11:
are often confused by English speakers.

The joke is so well known that it has become a piece of Austrian pop culture.

But technically, “no kangaroos in Austria” is not quite accurate.

Kangaroos aren't native wild animals of Austria, but individual kangaroos can be kept in captivity — and, as this week's bizarre series of sightings demonstrates, one can occasionally end up somewhere it definitely isn't expected to be.

So perhaps the more accurate slogan is:

NO NATIVE WILD KANGAROOS IN AUSTRIA.

Not quite as catchy.

One thing is certain

For the drivers who encountered the animal, this was no ordinary drive home.

A quiet night near Langenlois suddenly became a story involving a kangaroo, a police call, an hour-long animal chase and a dead car battery.

And the next morning, another driver spotted the same mysterious visitor hopping through the countryside.

Until someone discovers where “Sydney” came from, Lower Austria has a rather unusual resident.

Australia may be thousands of kilometres away — but this weekend, it certainly felt a little closer.

US Bombers Depart UK for American Bases,"","

The US has withdrawn its bombers from RAF Fairford in Gloucestershire, a military base that is currently being investigated by counter-terrorism police, after an incident last weeking


The Pentagon (the United State's Military Command Office) said on Sunday that the aircraft, which are believed to include around 12 B-1 aircraft, had left the UK and gone back to their bases in the United States. What is not clear is why the US decided to move them. Officials have not given a specific reason.


The decision comes just days after an incident in close proximity to the base on 27 September 2026. Police were called after three vehicles were reported as suspicious near RAF Fairford. Five men were arrested at the time, and another man was arrested later in London. All of them have since been released on bail while the investigation continues.


It has not been officially confirmed that the bomber withdrawal is connected to the incident. However, UK government sources have not denied that there could be a connection. The decision was apparently made by the US military itself and was described as an operational decision rather than a political one.


People tracking military aircraft also reported seeing B-1 bombers leaving RAF Fairford on Sunday. The UK Ministry of Defence has not said much about the situation.


There has also been speculation about Iran's possible involvement. A few days after the incident, Prime Minister Andy Burnham said there were ""strong indications"" that Iran had played a role. He did not explain what those indications were, though, and Iran has completely denied being involved.


The first five men who were arrested were aged between 23 and 25 and were all from London. They were initially arrested over suspected explosives offences and were later suspected of preparing a terrorist act. Police eventually released them on bail, saying that this was part of their investigation.


The sixth man, who is 25 and has UK-Iranian nationality, was arrested in London on Thursday. He was also suspected of preparing terrorist acts but was later released on bail.


RAF Fairford has been used by the US Air Force for many years. Recently, it has been especially important because US B-1 and B-52 bombers have been using the base for operations connected to the Middle East. The UK had previously agreed to allow the US to use the base for defensive strikes involving Iran.


This is also happening at a time when tensions between the US and Iran are already high. In July, Iran warned that any military base used to attack Iranian territory could become a target.


US Secretary of State Marco Rubio previously said that the incident at Fairford appeared to involve a foreign actor. He did not say who he meant or give any more information. President Donald Trump also said he was surprised that the suspects had been released on bail, although he said the UK and US had been working closely together.


The B-1 bombers are powerful aircraft and can carry weapons designed to hit targets that are underground or heavily protected. They can also carry missiles for attacking targets from further away.


Even though the bombers have now left RAF Fairford, this does not mean the US cannot use them for military operations. The Pentagon has said that the aircraft can still carry out missions from bases in the United States.


For now, nobody has given a definite explanation for why the bombers were moved. The timing is certainly interesting because the withdrawal happened soon after the incident at RAF Fairford. Whether the two things are actually connected, however, is something that remains unclear while the investigation is still going on.

French Students Take to the Streets Over Their Schools

Thousands of students across France have been protesting about the conditions in their schools, and some of the protests have turned violent.


The protests first started in Paris but have now spread to other cities, including Brest, Nantes, Marseille and Montpellier.


Students have been blocking the entrances to schools and roads to get attention from the government.

So, what are they actually protesting about?


Many students say their schools don't have enough teachers, classrooms are too crowded and some buildings are in poor condition. They have also complained about long school days and classrooms getting too hot.


The protests have caused a lot of disruption. French officials said 735 schools had been affected, out of around 3,700 across the country. Interior Minister Laurent Nuñez said 1,747 people were arrested on Friday.


Things have also become dangerous in some areas. Police have clashed with protesters, and tear gas was used in Strasbourg. In Pantin, near Paris, police arrested protesters after objects were thrown at officers.


Fires have also been started in some cities. Rubbish bins and barricades were set on fire in places including Paris and Rennes.


One of the most serious incidents happened in Belfort, where a police officer was attacked during the protests. A 17-year-old was arrested in connection with the attack. The education ministry also said that at least 65 members of staff had been injured.


Some schools have been badly damaged too. At Nelson Mandela High School in Nantes, a fire destroyed the school's glass entrance and damaged parts of the building. Officials estimated the damage at more than €2m.


Despite the violence, many students say they are protesting because they want their everyday problems at school to be taken seriously.


One 16-year-old protester, Lola, said that police actions were making students even more angry. However, some parents are worried about their children being involved in protests that could become dangerous.


The French government has said that people who damage property or attack others could face consequences. Justice Minister Gérald Darmanin has also said that parents could potentially be responsible for damage caused by their children.

Several trade unions have backed the students' right to protest.


For now, the protests are still going on, and it's unclear what will happen next. But one thing is clear: many French students want the government to pay more attention to what's happening inside their schools.

E-Mopeds Are No Longer Allowed on Vienna’s Bike Paths,"","

VIENNA — October 1, 2026


People using Vienna’s bike paths will see a change from today. E-mopeds are no longer allowed to use cycle paths and cycle lanes across Austria.


Until now, some e-mopeds were treated in a similar way to bicycles. That changes from October 1. They are now legally treated as mopeds, meaning they have to be used on public roads instead of bicycle infrastructure.


The new rules also mean more requirements for owners. E-mopeds must be registered and insured, and they have to undergo regular inspections under §57a of Austria’s Motor Vehicle Act. This means they need the familiar “Pickerl” inspection sticker. Riders also need a driving license and must wear a helmet.


The City of Vienna says the changes should make cycling safer. Mobility Councillor Ulli Sima has supported the removal of e-mopeds from cycle paths, saying that some were traveling too quickly and that their weight could be dangerous for cyclists and pedestrians.


“Cyclists should be able to travel safely on cycle paths,” Sima said.


The government says the changes are intended to create clearer rules for motorized two-wheelers. In Vienna, the new rules will also be enforced on the city’s streets and cycle network.


For cyclists, the change is fairly simple: vehicles that are legally considered mopeds now have to stay off the bike paths and share the road with other motor traffic.

Leeds Bradford Airport plans could mean more night flights,"","

Leeds Bradford Airport could be allowed to operate more night flights this summer if proposed changes to its current rules are approved.


The airport is currently limited to 2,920 aircraft movements between 11pm and 7am during the summer. However, airport bosses want to replace this limit with a system that focuses on the amount of noise produced by aircraft rather than simply counting the number of flights.


LBA is also proposing to reduce its official night-time hours to between 11.30pm and 5.59am. Leeds City Council is expected to decide on the plans later this autumn.

The airport currently operates around 18 night flights a day during the summer, meaning the proposed changes could allow this number to increase.


The airport's chief executive, Vincent Hodder, said the changes would not simply remove restrictions on night flights.

Speaking to the BBC, Mr Hodder said ""absolutely not"" when asked if the airport was trying to abolish the cap on night flights.


Instead, he said the airport wanted to focus on the noise created by aircraft rather than simply the number of flights.

Under the proposed system, quieter and newer aircraft would use fewer ""quota points"", while older and noisier aircraft would use more. LBA says the proposed limit of 1,450 quota points would mean the overall level of noise could not be higher than what is currently permitted.


Mr Hodder said the changes would allow airlines based at the airport, including Jet2 and Ryanair, to expand their operations while encouraging them to use quieter aircraft.

But for people living underneath the flight path, the issue is less about the type of aircraft and more about being woken up at night.


Horsforth resident Cal Bailey has lived under the flight path for 30 years. He says night flights regularly disturb his sleep.

The airport has offered £5,500 grants to 700 homes in areas affected by aircraft noise. The money could be used for measures such as insulation or air conditioning, which could allow residents to keep their windows closed on warm summer nights.


However, Mr Bailey said he did not think these measures would solve the problem.

""I have insulated this house significantly since we moved in and air conditioning is not something I want to do,"" he said, describing it as highly energy intensive.


""I think local residents deserve to have the opportunity to sleep well at night.""

The debate now comes down to what happens when an airport's plans for growth meet the everyday lives of people living nearby.


LBA says the changes could help airlines grow and create more jobs locally, while residents and campaigners are concerned about the effect of additional night flights on their sleep.


With Leeds City Council due to consider the proposals later this year, the question of how much night-time flying the airport should be allowed to do is likely to remain an important issue for people living around the flight path.

Kürbisfest Is Coming to VIS!


Fall is here, which means it’s time for costumes, pumpkins, and lots of treats. This year, VIS is getting a new fall event: the first Annual Kürbisfest, happening in the VIS car park.

Iran linked to RAF Fairford incident, says Andy Burnham,"","

Prime Minister Andy Burnham has said there are “strong indications” that Iran may have been involved in the incident at RAF Fairford, where five men were arrested and later released on bail.


Speaking to the BBC, Burnham said the government believed Iran had “played a part” in what happened, although he did not explain exactly what evidence had led to this conclusion.


Iran has denied the claims. Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi criticised the UK government, saying it was “barking up the wrong tree”. The Iranian embassy in London had also previously rejected what it called “unfounded and malicious speculations” linking Iran to the incident.


The five men were arrested early on Sunday morning after police were called about three suspicious vehicles in Whelford, a village close to RAF Fairford.


All five men are British and are aged between 23 and 25. Four of the suspects that were arrested are from Westminster, while the fifth is from Camden. Police have also finished searching their homes as part of the investigation.


The men were later released on bail. Burnham said this did not mean they were simply free to go, explaining that they were under very strict bail conditions. He said the authorities had the situation under the “strongest grip and closest control”.


US President Donald Trump questioned the decision to release the suspects. Speaking at the White House, he said he would not have allowed them to be released on bail and that he was surprised by the decision.


US Secretary of State Marco Rubio also said the incident “clearly involves the hands of a foreign actor”. However, he did not directly confirm that Iran was responsible.


Police searching the vehicles found a quantity of petrol but no explosives. The investigation is still ongoing.

It was also revealed that one of the five men had called 999 himself before the group were arrested.


RAF Fairford has been used by the US Air Force for many years. More recently, US bombers have operated from the base for missions in the Middle East. The UK government previously approved a US request to use the base for what it described as defensive strikes against Iran.


Iran warned in July that any base used for attacks against Iranian territory could be considered a legitimate target.

Burnham said British officials had been working closely with their American counterparts and that he had full confidence in the way British security services were handling the situation.


He said the investigation remained “ongoing, complex and serious” and that more information would be given when the authorities were able to release it.

قال رئيس الوزراء آندي بورنهام إن هناك \""مؤشرات قوية\"" على أن إيران ربما تكون متورطة في الحادث الذي وقع في سلاح الجو الملكي البريطاني في فيرفورد، حيث تم القبض على خمسة رجال ثم أطلق سراحهم بكفالة.


وفي حديثه إلى بي بي سي، قال بورنهام إن الحكومة تعتقد أن إيران \""لعبت دورًا\"" في ما حدث، على الرغم من أنه لم يوضح بالضبط الأدلة التي أدت إلى هذا الاستنتاج.


ونفت إيران هذه المزاعم. وانتقد وزير الخارجية عباس عراقجي حكومة المملكة المتحدة، قائلا إنها \""تنبح الشجرة الخطأ\"". كما رفضت السفارة الإيرانية في لندن سابقًا ما أسمته \""تكهنات خبيثة لا أساس لها\"" تربط إيران بالحادث.


تم القبض على الرجال الخمسة في وقت مبكر من صباح يوم الأحد بعد استدعاء الشرطة بشأن ثلاث مركبات مشبوهة في ويلفورد، وهي قرية قريبة من سلاح الجو الملكي البريطاني فيرفورد.


جميع الرجال الخمسة بريطانيون وتتراوح أعمارهم بين 23 و25 عامًا. أربعة من المشتبه بهم الذين تم القبض عليهم هم من وستمنستر، بينما الخامس هو من كامدن. كما أنهت الشرطة تفتيش منازلهم كجزء من التحقيق.


تم إطلاق سراح الرجال لاحقًا بكفالة. وقال بورنهام إن هذا لا يعني أنهم ببساطة أحرار في المغادرة، موضحًا أنهم يخضعون لشروط كفالة صارمة للغاية. وقال إن السلطات وضعت الوضع تحت \""أشد قبضة وأقرب سيطرة\"".


وشكك الرئيس الأمريكي دونالد ترامب في قرار إطلاق سراح المشتبه بهم. وفي حديثه في البيت الأبيض، قال إنه لم يكن ليسمح بالإفراج عنهم بكفالة وإنه فوجئ بالقرار.


وقال وزير الخارجية الأمريكي ماركو روبيو أيضًا إن الحادث \""من الواضح أنه يتعلق بأيدي جهة أجنبية\"". لكنه لم يؤكد بشكل مباشر مسؤولية إيران.


وعثرت الشرطة التي فتشت المركبات على كمية من البنزين ولكن لم تعثر على متفجرات. لا يزال التحقيق مستمرًا.

تم الكشف أيضًا عن أن أحد الرجال الخمسة اتصل بالرقم 999 بنفسه قبل إلقاء القبض على المجموعة.


تم استخدام سلاح الجو الملكي البريطاني فيرفورد من قبل القوات الجوية الأمريكية لسنوات عديدة. وفي الآونة الأخيرة، عملت القاذفات الأمريكية من القاعدة للقيام بمهام في الشرق الأوسط. وافقت حكومة المملكة المتحدة سابقًا على طلب أمريكي لاستخدام القاعدة لما وصفته بضربات دفاعية ضد إيران.


وحذرت إيران في يوليو/تموز من أن أي قاعدة تستخدم لشن هجمات ضد الأراضي الإيرانية يمكن اعتبارها هدفًا مشروعًا.

وقال بورنهام إن المسؤولين البريطانيين كانوا يعملون بشكل وثيق مع نظرائهم الأمريكيين وأن لديه ثقة كاملة في الطريقة التي تتعامل بها أجهزة الأمن البريطانية مع الوضع.


وقال إن التحقيق لا يزال \""مستمرًا ومعقدًا ومعقدًا\"". خطير\"" وأنه سيتم تقديم المزيد من المعلومات عندما تتمكن السلطات من نشره.

"",""subtitle"":""""},""de"":{""title"":""Iran steht im Zusammenhang mit dem Vorfall in Fairford bei der RAF, sagt Andy Burnham"",""content"":""

Premierminister Andy Burnham sagte, es gebe „starke Hinweise“ darauf, dass der Iran an dem Vorfall bei RAF Fairford beteiligt gewesen sein könnte, wo fünf Männer festgenommen und später gegen Kaution freigelassen wurden.


Im Gespräch mit der BBC sagte Burnham, die Regierung glaube, dass Iran „eine Rolle“ bei dem Geschehen gespielt habe, obwohl er nicht genau erklärte, welche Beweise zu dieser Schlussfolgerung geführt hätten.


Iran hat die Behauptungen zurückgewiesen. Außenminister Abbas Araghchi kritisierte die britische Regierung und sagte, sie sei „auf dem Holzweg“. Auch die iranische Botschaft in London hatte zuvor „unbegründete und böswillige Spekulationen“ zurückgewiesen, die den Iran mit dem Vorfall in Verbindung brachten.


Die fünf Männer wurden am frühen Sonntagmorgen festgenommen, nachdem die Polizei wegen drei verdächtiger Fahrzeuge in Whelford, einem Dorf in der Nähe von RAF Fairford, gerufen worden war.


Alle fünf Männer sind Briten und zwischen 23 und 25 Jahre alt. Vier der Verdächtigen, die festgenommen wurden stammen aus Westminster, während der fünfte aus Camden stammt. Im Rahmen der Ermittlungen hat die Polizei auch die Durchsuchung ihrer Häuser abgeschlossen.


Die Männer wurden später gegen Kaution freigelassen. Burnham sagte, dies bedeute nicht, dass sie einfach gehen könnten, und erklärte, dass für sie sehr strenge Auflagen gegen Kaution galten. Er sagte, die Behörden hätten die Situation „stärkster Kontrolle und bester Kontrolle“.


US-Präsident Donald Trump stellte die Entscheidung zur Freilassung der Verdächtigen in Frage. Bei einer Rede im Weißen Haus sagte er, er hätte nicht zugelassen, dass sie gegen Kaution freigelassen würden, und er sei von der Entscheidung überrascht.


US-Außenminister Marco Rubio sagte auch, dass der Vorfall „eindeutig die Hände eines ausländischen Schauspielers betrifft“. Allerdings bestätigte er nicht direkt, dass der Iran dafür verantwortlich sei.


Die Polizei, die die Fahrzeuge durchsuchte, fand eine Menge Benzin, aber keinen Sprengstoff. Die Ermittlungen dauern noch an.

Es wurde außerdem bekannt, dass einer der fünf Männer vor der Festnahme der Gruppe selbst die Notrufnummer 999 angerufen hatte.


RAF Fairford wird seit vielen Jahren von der US-Luftwaffe eingesetzt. In jüngerer Zeit operierten US-Bomber von der Basis aus zu Einsätzen im Nahen Osten. Die britische Regierung hatte zuvor einem Antrag der USA zugestimmt, den Stützpunkt für Verteidigungsschläge gegen den Iran zu nutzen.


Iran warnte im Juli, dass jeder Stützpunkt, der für Angriffe auf iranisches Territorium genutzt werde, als legitimes Ziel angesehen werden könne.

Burnham sagte, britische Beamte hätten eng mit ihren amerikanischen Kollegen zusammengearbeitet und er habe volles Vertrauen in die Art und Weise, wie die britischen Sicherheitsdienste mit der Situation umgingen.


Er sagte, die Ermittlungen seien noch nicht abgeschlossen „andauernd, komplex und ernst“ und dass weitere Informationen bereitgestellt würden, sobald die Behörden in der Lage wären, sie zu veröffentlichen.

"",""subtitle"":""""},""ru"":{""title"":""Иран связан с инцидентом с ВВС Великобритании в Фэрфорде, говорит Энди Бёрнем"",""content"":""

Премьер-министр Энди Бёрнэм заявил, что существуют «веские признаки» того, что Иран мог быть причастен к инциденту в ВВС Фэрфорда, где пять человек были арестованы и позже освобождены под залог.


В беседе с BBC Бёрнэм сказал, что правительство считает, что Иран «сыграл свою роль» в том, что произошло, хотя он не объяснил, какие именно доказательства привели к такому выводу.


Иран опроверг эти утверждения. Министр иностранных дел Аббас Аракчи раскритиковал правительство Великобритании, заявив, что оно «лает не на то дерево». Посольство Ирана в Лондоне также ранее отвергло то, что оно назвало «необоснованными и злонамеренными предположениями» о связи Ирана с инцидентом.


Пятеро мужчин были арестованы рано утром в воскресенье после того, как в полицию позвонили по поводу трех подозрительных автомобилей в Уэлфорде, деревне недалеко от британских ВВС Фэрфорд.


Все пятеро мужчин - британцы в возрасте от 23 до 25 лет. Четверо арестованных подозреваемых - выходцы из Вестминстер, а пятый — из Камдена. В рамках расследования полиция также завершила обыски в их домах.


Мужчины позже были освобождены под залог. Бёрнем сказал, что это не означает, что они просто могут уйти, объяснив, что они находятся под очень строгими условиями освобождения под залог. Он заявил, что власти держат ситуацию под «жестчайшим контролем и самым строгим контролем».


Президент США Дональд Трамп поставил под сомнение решение об освобождении подозреваемых. Выступая в Белом доме, он заявил, что не позволил бы их освободить под залог и что он удивлен этим решением.


Госсекретарь США Марко Рубио также заявил, что в инциденте \""явно замешаны руки иностранного актера\"". Однако он не подтвердил прямо, что ответственность несет Иран.


Полиция, обыскивая автомобили, обнаружила некоторое количество бензина, но не обнаружила взрывчатых веществ. Расследование все еще продолжается.

Выяснилось также, что один из пяти мужчин сам позвонил в службу 999 до того, как группа была арестована.


RAF Fairford уже много лет используется ВВС США. Совсем недавно американские бомбардировщики действовали с базы для выполнения миссий на Ближнем Востоке. Правительство Великобритании ранее одобрило запрос США на использование базы для того, что оно назвало оборонительными ударами по Ирану.


В июле Иран предупредил, что любая база, используемая для атак на иранскую территорию, может считаться законной целью.

Бёрнхэм заявил, что британские официальные лица тесно сотрудничали со своими американскими коллегами и что он полностью уверен в том, как британские службы безопасности справляются с ситуацией.


Он сказал, что расследование «продолжается, сложный и серьезный» и что дополнительная информация будет предоставлена, когда власти смогут ее опубликовать.

"",""subtitle"":""""},""fr"":{""title"":""L'Iran est lié à l'incident de la RAF Fairford, déclare Andy Burnham"",""content"":""

Le Premier ministre Andy Burnham a déclaré qu'il y avait de « fortes indications » que l'Iran pourrait avoir été impliqué dans l'incident de la RAF Fairford, où cinq hommes ont été arrêtés puis libérés sous caution.


S'adressant à la BBC, Burnham a déclaré que le gouvernement pensait que l'Iran avait « joué un rôle » dans ce qui s'est passé, bien qu'il n'ait pas expliqué exactement quelles preuves avaient conduit à cette conclusion.


L'Iran a nié ces affirmations. Le ministre des Affaires étrangères Abbas Araghchi a critiqué le gouvernement britannique, affirmant qu’il « se trompait d’arbre ». L'ambassade d'Iran à Londres avait également précédemment rejeté ce qu'elle qualifiait de « spéculations infondées et malveillantes » liant l'Iran à l'incident.


Les cinq hommes ont été arrêtés tôt dimanche matin après que la police a été appelée au sujet de trois véhicules suspects à Whelford, un village proche de la RAF Fairford.


Les cinq hommes sont britanniques et sont âgés entre 23 et 25 ans. Quatre des suspects arrêtés sont originaires de Westminster, tandis que le cinquième vient de Camden. La police a également terminé de fouiller leurs domiciles dans le cadre de l'enquête.


Les hommes ont ensuite été libérés sous caution. Burnham a déclaré que cela ne signifiait pas qu'ils étaient simplement libres de partir, expliquant qu'ils étaient soumis à des conditions de libération sous caution très strictes. Il a déclaré que les autorités contrôlaient la situation de la manière la plus forte et la plus étroite possible.


Le président américain Donald Trump a remis en question la décision de libérer les suspects. S'exprimant à la Maison Blanche, il a déclaré qu'il n'aurait pas autorisé leur libération sous caution et qu'il était surpris par la décision.


Le secrétaire d'État américain Marco Rubio a également déclaré que l'incident \""impliquait clairement les mains d'un acteur étranger\"". Cependant, il n'a pas directement confirmé que l'Iran était responsable.


La police fouillant les véhicules a trouvé une quantité d'essence mais aucun explosif. L'enquête est toujours en cours.

Il a également été révélé que l'un des cinq hommes avait lui-même appelé le 999 avant l'arrestation du groupe.


La RAF Fairford est utilisée par l'US Air Force depuis de nombreuses années. Plus récemment, des bombardiers américains ont opéré depuis cette base pour des missions au Moyen-Orient. Le gouvernement britannique avait précédemment approuvé une demande américaine d'utiliser la base pour ce qu'il a décrit comme des frappes défensives contre l'Iran.


L'Iran a averti en juillet que toute base utilisée pour des attaques contre le territoire iranien pourrait être considérée comme une cible légitime.

Burnham a déclaré que les responsables britanniques avaient travaillé en étroite collaboration avec leurs homologues américains et qu'il avait pleinement confiance dans la façon dont les services de sécurité britanniques géraient la situation.


Il a déclaré que l'enquête restait « en cours, complexe et sérieuse ». et que plus d'informations seraient fournies lorsque les autorités seraient en mesure de les publier.

总理安迪·伯纳姆表示，有“强烈迹象”表明伊朗可能参与了英国皇家空军费尔福德事件，五名男子被捕，后来被保释。


伯纳姆在接受 BBC 采访时表示，政府相信伊朗在所发生的事件中“发挥了作用”，尽管他没有具体解释是什么证据导致了这一事件。结论。


伊朗否认了这些说法。外交部长阿巴斯·阿拉格奇批评英国政府，称其“找错了对象”。伊朗驻伦敦大使馆此前也否认了所谓的将伊朗与该事件联系起来的“毫无根据和恶意的猜测”。


周日清晨，警方接到电话称，在皇家空军费尔福德附近的村庄威尔福德发现了三辆可疑车辆，这五名男子被捕。


所有五名男子都是英国人，年龄在 23 至 25 岁之间。其中四名被捕嫌疑人来自威斯敏斯特，第五个来自卡姆登。作为调查的一部分，警方还完成了对他们家的搜查。


这些人后来被保释。伯纳姆说，这并不意味着他们就可以自由离开，并解释说他们的保释条件非常严格。他表示，当局对局势进行了“最强有力的控制和最密切的控制”。


美国总统唐纳德·特朗普对释放嫌疑人的决定提出质疑。他在白宫发表讲话时表示，他不会允许他们保释，并对这一决定感到惊讶。


美国国务卿马可·卢比奥也表示，该事件“显然涉及外国演员之手”。不过，他没有直接证实伊朗对此负责。


警方在搜查车辆时发现了大量汽油，但没有发现爆炸物。 调查仍在进行中。

据透露，五名男子中的一名在该团伙被捕之前曾拨打过 999。


RAF Fairford 已被美国空军使用多年。最近，美国轰炸机从该基地出发执行中东任务。英国政府此前批准了美国的请求，利用该基地对伊朗进行所谓的防御性打击。


伊朗在 7 月份警告称，任何用于攻击伊朗领土的基地都可能被视为合法目标。

伯纳姆表示，英国官员一直在与美国同行密切合作，他对英国安全部门处理这一情况的方式充满信心。

El primer ministro Andy Burnham ha dicho que hay “fuertes indicios” de que Irán pudo haber estado involucrado en el incidente en la RAF Fairford, donde cinco hombres fueron arrestados y luego liberados bajo fianza.


En declaraciones a la BBC, Burnham dijo que el gobierno creía que Irán había “jugado un papel” en lo sucedido, aunque no explicó exactamente qué evidencia había llevado a esta conclusión.


Irán ha negado las afirmaciones. El ministro de Asuntos Exteriores, Abbas Araghchi, criticó al gobierno del Reino Unido y dijo que estaba “ladrando al árbol equivocado”. La embajada iraní en Londres también había rechazado previamente lo que llamó “especulaciones infundadas y maliciosas” que vinculaban a Irán con el incidente.


Los cinco hombres fueron arrestados temprano el domingo por la mañana después de que la policía fuera llamada sobre tres vehículos sospechosos en Whelford, un pueblo cercano a RAF Fairford.


Los cinco hombres son británicos y tienen entre 23 y 25 años. Cuatro de los sospechosos que fueron arrestados son de Westminster, mientras que el quinto es de Camden. La policía también terminó de registrar sus casas como parte de la investigación.


Los hombres fueron liberados bajo fianza. Burnham dijo que esto no significaba que simplemente fueran libres de irse, y explicó que estaban bajo condiciones de fianza muy estrictas. Dijo que las autoridades tenían la situación bajo \""el más fuerte control y el más estrecho control\"".


El presidente de Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, cuestionó la decisión de liberar a los sospechosos. Hablando en la Casa Blanca, dijo que no habría permitido que fueran liberados bajo fianza y que estaba sorprendido por la decisión.


El Secretario de Estado de Estados Unidos, Marco Rubio, también dijo que el incidente “claramente involucra las manos de un actor extranjero”. Sin embargo, no confirmó directamente que Irán fuera el responsable.


La policía que registró los vehículos encontró cierta cantidad de gasolina, pero ningún explosivo. La investigación aún está en curso.

También se reveló que uno de los cinco hombres había llamado él mismo al 999 antes de que arrestaran al grupo.


La RAF Fairford ha sido utilizada por la Fuerza Aérea de EE. UU. durante muchos años. Más recientemente, bombarderos estadounidenses han operado desde la base para misiones en Medio Oriente. El gobierno del Reino Unido aprobó previamente una solicitud de Estados Unidos para usar la base para lo que describió como ataques defensivos contra Irán.


Irán advirtió en julio que cualquier base utilizada para ataques contra territorio iraní podría considerarse un objetivo legítimo.

Burnham dijo que los funcionarios británicos habían estado trabajando estrechamente con sus homólogos estadounidenses y que tenía plena confianza en la forma en que los servicios de seguridad británicos estaban manejando la situación.


Dijo que la investigación seguía “en curso y era compleja”. y grave” y que se daría más información cuando las autoridades pudieran divulgarla.

21st of September Monday, the campaign began, obvious due to the inescapable posters. While it mainly featured Tamim's orange ones, there were many others, including some from our own StuCo candidate, Lev!

And as for the future? Will the project slowly decay, and turn into a forgotten goal, or will it succeed and thrive? It has been one month and projects have already started, because we as students have come together to make them - ""Divided we fall, united we stand!""

Tom Cruise Takes His Biggest Risk Yet in Bizarre New Film,"","

Tom Cruise is famous for doing things most actors wouldn’t dream of — jumping from buildings, hanging off aircraft and performing some of Hollywood’s most dangerous stunts. But in his latest film, Digger, his biggest risk has nothing to do with planes, motorcycles or explosions.


Instead, Cruise takes on one of the strangest roles of his career, playing a wealthy, overweight Texas oil tycoon caught up in a massive environmental disaster.


In Digger, Cruise plays Digger Rockwell, an oil billionaire whose appearance is almost impossible to recognise. Gone is the familiar athletic look. With grey hair, prosthetic makeup and a noticeable belly, Cruise looks very different from the action hero audiences have become used to seeing.


The transformation becomes even more obvious in a scene where Rockwell appears in his underwear — a nod to Cruise's iconic role in Risky Business.


The film is directed and co-written by Alejandro G. Iñárritu, whose previous work includes Birdman and The Revenant. Unlike Cruise’s recent blockbuster films, Digger takes a much stranger and more challenging approach.


The story centres on Rockwell and his oil company, which is responsible for an environmental catastrophe in Alaska. After drilling causes a glacier to crack, a gigantic iceberg breaks away and begins drifting towards Europe. Scientists warn that its movement could eventually trigger a tsunami powerful enough to flood several major cities.


Rockwell, however, is not exactly eager to accept responsibility.

Rather than admitting fault, he points to the jobs his company provides and attempts to shift the blame elsewhere. His attitude becomes even more absurd when the US president, played by John Goodman, arrives at Rockwell’s mansion for an emergency meeting.


Politicians and military officials gather to figure out how to deal with the approaching iceberg, while also worrying about the potential damage to America's reputation.


Riz Ahmed plays a scientist trying to make the group understand just how serious the situation is. But the meeting quickly descends into chaos, with arguments, shouting and political calculations getting in the way of finding a solution.


On paper, the story sounds completely over the top. But that is also what makes it intriguing. With climate change, extreme weather and environmental disasters becoming regular subjects in the news, the film's outrageous scenario may not feel quite as impossible as it once would have.


And there is considerably more to Digger than the environmental crisis.

The movie reportedly contains two major twists that change the way audiences understand much of what they have seen. Details about those twists are being kept under wraps, so viewers will have to discover them for themselves.

Cruise's character is another major departure from the roles he normally plays. Rockwell is arrogant, extremely wealthy and obsessed with money. His huge mansion is packed with stuffed exotic animals, yet he shows an oddly genuine concern for the wellbeing of his small pet cat.


He also has a complicated relationship with his half-sister, played by Sandra Hüller, who works in the green-energy industry. The contrast between the two characters adds another layer to the film's deliberately strange sense of humour.

Not everyone is likely to react to Digger in the same way. Some viewers may enjoy its absurdity and unpredictability, while others may find it difficult to take seriously. At 128 minutes, the film also takes its time, which could test the patience of audiences during some of its longer scenes.


Still, Digger represents a noticeable change of direction for Cruise. After years of leading enormous action franchises, he has chosen a project that is considerably stranger, darker and less predictable.


It may not be another Mission: Impossible-sized blockbuster, but that seems to be beside the point. The film gives Cruise the chance to step away from the action-hero image that has defined much of his career and try something audiences aren't used to seeing from him.


For an actor who has spent decades making a career out of doing the unexpected, taking on one of Hollywood's strangest roles might actually be a fitting choice.

Counter-Terrorism Investigation Underway After RAF Fairford Arrests,"Five UK nationals were arrested near the Gloucestershire airbase after a farmer reported suspicious vans and a group of masked men, sparking a major police operation.","

A major counter-terrorism investigation was launched near RAF Fairford after five men were arrested following reports of suspicious vehicles close to the military airbase.


The incident began shortly after midnight on Sunday, when police received a call about three suspicious vehicles apparently travelling towards the airbase. Armed officers responded and arrested five men in the nearby village of Whelford. The men were initially arrested over suspected offences under the Explosives Act before being further arrested on suspicion of the preparation of a terrorist act.


A 400-metre cordon was established around the vehicles while Army Explosive Ordnance Disposal specialists examined them. Around 85 households were evacuated as a precaution, with residents directed to a nearby leisure centre while the operation was carried out.


The five suspects were all UK nationals and were aged between 23 and 25. Police later identified them as a 24-year-old from Camden, three men aged 23, 24 and 25 from Westminster, and another 24-year-old from Willesden in north-west London.


The investigation has involved local and national police, the Ministry of Defence and other agencies. Counter Terrorism Policing described the operation as a “hugely complex and large-scale operation”.


Deputy Assistant Commissioner Vicki Evans said:

“This is a hugely complex and large-scale operation, involving local and national policing, the MoD, and local agencies, who are working together to progress the investigation and support for the community.


“I know this has been incredibly disruptive for local people, but I’d like to reassure them that our activity is in the interest of national security, but most importantly in the interest of their own safety.""


Farmer raises the alarm

The police response began after a local farmer noticed three vans parked in what she described as a “weird formation” in a “loop” in Whelford.


“When you live in Whelford, you notice everything,” she said, explaining that residents know the people and vehicles normally found in the village.


The farmer said the vans had “strange signage” and that she initially thought something was wrong.

“I looked at it and thought ‘that is not real’,” she said.


She stopped to look at the vehicles and attempted to call a phone number displayed on one of the vans, but the call did not work.


As she turned around, she said she saw a “large group” of men who appeared to panic after noticing her. She described them as wearing similar clothing with their faces covered.


The farmer first tried contacting the Ministry of Defence Police and the base liaison number.

“The phone rang and rang and rang,” she said.


She then called 999 and alerted other residents through a local WhatsApp group.

“Literally within five minutes it all kicked off,"" she added. ""There were armed police, a helicopter.”


The farmer later told the BBC that she was “100% certain” she had seen between eight and 10 people fleeing towards trees. She said the group appeared not to be local, based on their behaviour rather than their appearance.


Residents reported earlier security concerns

Other residents also described unusual activity around RAF Fairford in the days before the arrests.

One villager reported seeing a man wearing a backpack emerge from bushes near the airbase at around 05:30 BST on Friday.


On Saturday afternoon, another resident walking their dog said armed police told them to return home and stay indoors. A third resident said local people were told to go home by armed officers just hours before the arrests.


Whitehall sources told the BBC that the operation was not “intelligence-led”. Police have urged the public not to speculate about the circumstances or possible motive while investigators continue their work.


Deputy Assistant Commissioner Vicki Evans said:

""I am very aware of the levels of speculation about the motivation behind this incident, and the geopolitical questions that are being raised.

""However, I ask that at this time, Counter Terrorism Policing are given the space to work carefully and clearly.”


Possible motives remain under investigation

The incident has led to speculation about whether the suspects could have been acting on behalf of a foreign state. RAF Fairford is an important base for the US Air Force and has been used in recent military operations involving Iran.


BBC security correspondent Frank Gardner said the base is strategically important to the United States.

“It’s incredibly useful strategically for the US to have this platform,” he said.


Gardner also discussed previous restrictions on the use of British bases in military operations involving Iran. However, police have not publicly confirmed that Iran was responsible for the incident.


Streeting said authorities were not yet in a position to identify the suspects' motives.

""At this stage in the investigation, I'm not in a position to comment on the identities of these individuals, or their aims and motivations,"" he said.


He added that more information about the suspects and their backgrounds would be provided as the investigation developed.


""We know that it is a matter of public record, that the Iranian regime is one that would do harm to our interests and to our allies given the chance, and I'm proud of the work that we do, all year and every year, to detect and to deter and prevent Iran from carrying out acts of harm.""


Investigation continues

Counter Terrorism Policing said investigators were examining the circumstances surrounding the suspects, their knowledge of the activity and any possible motivation.


The five men were initially held under the Police and Criminal Evidence Act. By 29 September, all five had been released on bail while the investigation continued. Police have not publicly confirmed who, if anyone, was behind the suspected plot.


Authorities have continued to investigate multiple possible lines of inquiry and have asked the public to avoid speculation while investigators establish the facts.


RAF Fairford remains a significant military facility used by the US Air Force, making the incident a major security concern for both British and American authorities.


The investigation remains ongoing. More information is expected as the investigation continues.

Helicopter Stolen From Salzburg Airfield Overnight,"A Robinson R44 was taken from Mauterndorf airfield early Monday morning, with police now investigating how the aircraft was flown out of Austria.","

A helicopter was stolen from an airfield in Mauterndorf, Salzburg, during the early hours of Monday morning. The helicopter, a Robinson R44, is used by the company of former ski-jumping Olympic champion Thomas Morgenstern.


According to Salzburg police, the helicopter was started at around 1:50 a.m. on September 28. A member of the flying club who was at the airfield heard the sound of the helicopter taking off. When he could not contact the pilot, he went to check what had happened.


He then discovered damage and signs of a break-in at the entrance to the hangar where the helicopter had been stored. The aircraft had disappeared from the airfield.


The helicopter reportedly flew south after being taken. Austrian media reported that it may have been in Croatian airspace at around 4:30 a.m. The exact route and current location of the helicopter have not been confirmed by police.


The helicopter belongs to Wagrain businessman Manuel Aster and is used by Morgenstern's company for transport and photography flights. Aster said he was initially shocked when police contacted him during the night, thinking the call might have been a joke.


There are still many unanswered questions about how the theft was carried out. Reports say the thieves also took fuel from the airfield. The helicopter's equipment was reportedly interfered with, including its emergency transmitter. These details have led the owner to believe that the people responsible may have had experience with helicopters or technical equipment.


The theft has also raised questions about how the helicopter was able to leave Austria during the night. However, it is not yet clear exactly how the flight was tracked or whether the aircraft was detected by radar.


The Salzburg State Criminal Police Office is investigating the case. Police have said that the investigation is continuing in all directions and have not publicly identified any suspects.


For now, the helicopter remains missing, while investigators work to establish who took it, how they managed to fly it away and where it has gone.


Sources: Salzburg Police, ORF Salzburg, Kleine Zeitung.

The CIA: America's Secret Force,"A Brief explanation of what the CIA truly is.","

When you imagine a secret inteligence service you might imagine James Bond, an agent who gathers information in an exciting way with cool futuristic gadgets. But it isnt always like that, the CIA or the Central Inteligence Agency is a organization by the Uninted States of America. The CIA is focused on Avancing the Nations Inteligence by Gathering Inteligence (or Information) from sources around the world. During WW2 the united states Inteligence operations were undertaken by the Office of Strategic Services or the OSS. Many of the future CIA officers including four directors served in the OSS . After the Second World (1945) war President Truman signed and executive act which dissolved the OSS and by october of the same year its functions have been split with the Department of State and Department of War, yet the Division only lasted for a couple Months. Then on July 26, 1947 when President Truman signed the National Security act into law a major dividing force for the creation of the agency was growing with the tenstions with the USSR. After that Lawrence Houston, head of the SSU,CIG and later the CIA established the Central Inteligence Agency.


Now the CIA doe the following Jobs:


  1. Gathering Inteligence – Gathering information abroad through Human Sources (Spies, Agents, Informants). This practice is callet HUMINT (or Human Inteligence) and this distinguishes the CIA from the NSA which uses intercepted communications or signals inteligence.
  2. Analysis – Analysis of raw inteligence from various sources assements for polivymakers including the President's Daily Brief. This covers Technological, Political and Military Developments around the World
  3. Covert Action – Cunduct secret operations abroad on behalf of the United States Government authorized by the presedential ""findings"". Historical examples include supporting coups, funding opposition groups, paramilitary operations, and drone strikes in some eras.
  4. Counter Inteligence – Detecting and countering espionage by foreign inteligence services that stand against the US government.


In Conclusion the CIA gathers Inteligence unlike popular belief that it carries out missions in law inforcement as both agencies (so the CIA adn FBI) are federal which means that this can be a common misconception. This means the CIA gathers information to imporve national security.
